files.content:
# Q2 Board Brief

Company: Harbor & Finch.
Revenue: $4.8M Q2, up 18% QoQ. Gross margin: 41%. Cash runway: 14 months.
KPIs: first response 6 hours, refund leakage 8.9%, warehouse SLA 96%, NPS 42.
Goals: returns automation pilot complete in West; East rollout pending Finance exception export.
Risks: carrier scan delays in Zone 5; Monday photo-review queue exceeds SLA.
Board asks: approve $220K automation budget and endorse East warehouse rollout.
Appendix: metric definitions and pilot scope.
